title: Math Magic
howToPlay: Answer each clue with a number, then follow the instruction beneath it. Work strictly top to bottom — each step acts on the running total so far, NOT on the individual numbers. The final result will be the answer to life, the universe, and everything.
scoring: 1 point per correct answer (10 possible), plus 5 points for the correct final result.
